description: Serial reference model for atomic document array updates and recovery

runs.source_revision: b180ef7 (worktree candidate; production code matches main revision 13befe8)

environment: Linux cloud VM; local temporary corpus and store
scope: Generated sequences of push, add-unique, remove, pop, rejected non-array mutations, explicit rollback and reopen are compared with an independent value model and unique-index checks on ordinary and checkpoint-backed stores. Short serial fuzz runs do not exhaust concurrent schedules, fault states, physical power loss or off-host restoration.
